description: G7 iOS AUv3, column A (PULP_ENABLE_GPU=OFF), iOS 27.0 simulator (arm64): PulpSineSynth.app (PulpSineSynth_HostApp, Xcode build with code signing allowed, the simulator's ad-hoc 'Sign to Run Locally' identity) with PulpSineSynth.appex embedded by the PulpSineSynth_HostApp_Embed target. Re-sealed inside out (extension, then app; codesign --force --sign - --preserve-metadata=identifier,entitlements, never --deep), the order tools/scripts/check_apple_bundle_signing.sh and `pulp ship sign` use, because the build embeds the extension after the app was signed.

declared_gaps.reason: this lane proves the extension is sealed, installs on a booted simulator and is registered with pluginkit; it does not instantiate the AUv3, open its editor or render. Pulp has no in-simulator AUv3 host probe (an AVAudioEngine manual-rendering harness would render offline without an audio device).
the simulator installs and registers bundles whose seal does not verify; a device does not. The seal is therefore checked by codesign here, not by the install.
